steps.description: Compliance team initiates the exam preparation process upon receipt of the regulatory examination notice. The full response package must be prepared within 30 days.

evidence.quote: Upon receipt of a regulatory examination notice, the Compliance team initiates the exam preparation process. The response package must be prepared within 30 days of receiving the notice.

steps.description: Legal collects and compiles its relevant documents in parallel within the first 20 days.

evidence.quote: Legal, Finance, and Operations collect and compile their relevant documents in parallel within the first 20 days.

steps.description: Compliance reviews all collected materials and assembles the final exam package.

evidence.quote: Compliance reviews all collected materials and assembles the final exam package.

steps.description: The General Counsel reviews and approves the completed exam package before it is submitted to the regulator. GC approval is required (rather than DGC) when the examination involves a consent order or enforcement action.

evidence.quote: The General Counsel must review and approve the completed exam package before it is submitted to the regulator.
DGC approval is sufficient unless the examination involves a consent order or enforcement action.

steps.description: Compliance submits the approved exam package to the regulator no later than 2 business days before the scheduled examination date.

evidence.quote: The final exam package must be submitted to the regulator no later than 2 business days before the scheduled examination date.
